summary: No blocking source defect found. Exact full-Train own-history teacher/519-value features/real-GT label path passes source and pure CPU checks; target admission, concrete gate and R2 runtime remain unverified.

nonblocking_findings.title: R2 source approval has no runtime completion claim
nonblocking_findings.details: No source integrity defect was established. Actual full-manifest collection/replay and a terminal raw-artifact/GT audit are still unexecuted in the reviewed evidence. The R1 report remains a one-prefix prior, and CPU checks do not extend it to all sequences or GPU kernels.

nonblocking_findings.title: Target resource, storage and concrete launch material remain separate prerequisites
nonblocking_findings.details: The supplemental BytesIO sizing and arithmetic reproduce exactly: 14656995328 modeled PT bytes plus 1073741824 reserve = 15730737152 modeled free bytes. These are 13.650390625 and 14.650390625 GiB. The 12-container maximum, 64KiB rounding and 1GiB reserve are planning assumptions. No target-environment disk serializer/filesystem witness, current target free-space/resource admission or concrete SHA-bound R2 gate/argv/deployment inventory is supplied. Do not convert source PASS or this modeled threshold into launch readiness. The controller verifies provided bound_files but cannot attest an as-yet-unprovided gate inventory.

nonblocking_findings.title: The fixed 519-value input contract is prospective for both C arms
nonblocking_findings.details: The shared helper is current/past only and its order/dtype are fixed before collection. No C training/deployment implementation exists in this scope, so equality of two actually trained arms is not demonstrated. R3 must consume the same cached C_input/common eligible rows, pin this helper/contract/dimension in its spec, and source-audit deployment use before any C optimization. The 32-sequence split is a holdout for C optimization only; A+B already saw all 152 sequences.

nonblocking_findings.title: Keep the immutable bank exception and historical spec semantics explicit
nonblocking_findings.details: The fixed bank and labels match trained P1, including pine02_wild_320 with five semicolon clauses in one attribute slot and human_status=conflicting despite the historical confirmation declaration. No regeneration occurs. The reused training_spec has historical M82 metadata and old text/optimizer fields; context uses its dataset/sequence/checkpoint/seed fields and takes the actual human bank/labels from the trained P1 binding. Do not reinterpret stale metadata as a new generated-text protocol, or silently rewrite the immutable bank/spec.

nonblocking_findings.title: The planned uninterrupted-W witness proves records, not unsaved prefix tensors
nonblocking_findings.details: All future W records are compared to a full same-GPU prefix in the new source, and frozen model/decoder digest values are now designed to be saved. The original prefix still stores only JSON control/prediction records, so its query and selected-feature tensors cannot be independently compared. Mutable fork ownership and restoration pass CPU container checks, while GPU transfer/RNG restoration, first-reference neural projection and real full-run W correspondence remain unexecuted. Preserve these proof limits in the later runtime audit.

deterministic_acceptance: accepted only for hash-bound static and pure CPU tensor/serializer receipts

A_gt_provenance.scope: source and fixed-material binding; no R2 runtime label audit
A_gt_provenance.details: The called label loader reads each sequence groundtruth.txt, verifies its locked SHA and frame count, and checks the legal first box. The sole historical toy07_indoor_320 exception truncates 1406 annotation rows to the already specified 1367 paired images. Collection never loads current/future GT: its own-history actor reads only the legal first image/box, fixed human bank and subsequent RGB/depth images. Replay serializes both predicted histories before load_truth. Current quality labels and future signed utility therefore have dataset-GT provenance by source, not prediction-derived reference. The physical P1 final, bank, labels and full Train spec were directly rehashed; the locally available cube04 GT was loaded on CPU and matched its spec/initial box. The other 151 raw sequence GT files and R2 label outputs were not supplied or reread, so full runtime provenance remains a later audit.

B_score_normalization.details: IoU divides geometric intersection by geometric union, never by maximum/mean/minimum predicted confidence. delta_future is the arithmetic mean of signed IoU(write)-IoU(keep) over dataset-valid future frames. Invalid GT gives null IoUs; empty-valid-future gives a null delta. Negative and zero values are not clipped, thresholded, rectified or filtered. Decoder probability/native ratios and feature normalization are inference transforms; the imported historical preservation loss is not called by this teacher and does not supply its labels. CPU fixtures independently exercised negative, positive, zero, invalid-current, empty-future and all-invalid-future behavior. These fixtures are logic tests, not tracking results.

C_result_existence.details: The prepared source and its contract exist with all 20 manifest SHA/size bindings exact. The prepared receipt explicitly records zero NN calls, no deployment and source review pending at preparation time. Historical R1 completion/audit hashes close correctly and are retained as prior pilot evidence. No R2 gate.json, deployment/source readback, original controller launch, child launches/exits, teacher manifest, raw R2 PTs or completed result is present in this reviewed inventory. Four NN stages are planned in controller source; no R2 launch or full-teacher result is established. The CPU BytesIO receipt is real sizing evidence with a stated limit, not a missing R2 result substitute.

D_called_computations.scope: reachable source graph, not executed R2 call graph
D_called_computations.details: main routes through the fixed R1 context to collect or replay. collect calls initial_reference, actor.step, event_from_native_write, pack_event and write_features on every actual write. replay calls legal initialize, reconstructs the shared state, calls unpack_event, restores RNG, invokes W/K, compares every available W record to the full prefix, serializes trajectories and then computes GT labels. Every label/feature helper has a caller. The R1 collect/replay entry points, K/K probe, historical training main/optimizer, official benchmark evaluators and C optimization are not called. C_input is deliberately a saved future training input; R2 replay only checks its contract/shape, and no C decision head consumes it here.

E_scope.details: The proposed source covers original Train152 once, seed 2027, fixed P1 final/human text, with 76 complete sequences per physical GPU and 219802 noninitialization steps in total. Shards imply 107060 and 112742 steps. 4324 is the maximum number of 50-frame checkpoints, not the unknown .75-qualified event count; their maximum W/K future calls sum to 273044 after tail truncation. The earlier observed evidence is only the 12-event cube04 prefix. This review runs zero tracking steps, produces zero R2 teacher samples, fits no C, and supplies no nine-metric final result. Sequence partition is deterministic and complete but not equal observed event/workload partition; conditional rate estimates must keep that qualifier.

F_evaluation_type.details: Prospective current/future IoU and delta labels are real_gt Train-only teacher diagnostics, conditional on the native policy accepting a write. W-versus-prefix record equality and historical K/K equality are self_supervised_proxy consistency evidence. Human text is human-provided initialization input, not human evaluation of tracking. Selected quality, observed-window intersection and native response are prediction features, not physical identity, phrase visibility, object existence or independent GT. CPU synthetic fixtures and zero-valued sizing placeholders are explicitly verification material and are never training samples or reported accuracy.

claims.claim: The exact reviewed R2 source has a coherent complete-Train own-history/WK/real-GT label path and fixed current/past 519-float32 feature transform; semantic approval remains same-family/provisional.

CPU roundtrip of 12 actual old R1 event containers preserves their old field values/aliases after shared-reference separation; CPU state-copy isolation and pure feature/label arithmetic pass. This is not CUDA unpack/rollout execution.
The 12-container BytesIO measurements and modeled 14.650390625-GiB free-space arithmetic reproduce; target current capacity and full-run bytes are unverified.
No R2 launch, 152-sequence runtime completion, actual eligible event count or actual full-run costs are established.
New source requires same-GPU W record correspondence to every available full-prefix future frame; no prefix query/feature tensor correspondence is claimed or stored.
No C optimizer, actual two-arm comparison, own-policy final C training, new benchmark improvement, multi-seed robustness or full-goal success has been demonstrated.

Prepare and verify the actual R2 gate.json and argv/deployment inventory: unchanged new/old reached source closure, immutable plan, exact P1 final/spec/trained result/bank/labels/native/CLIP, R0 six-result seal and R1/R2 audit hashes. Execute without Python assertion-disabling options; audit zero blocking flags are bound artifacts, not free-standing claims.

Retain original child starts, exit/receipt/logs and controller terminal result; verify all 152 prefix sequences/219802 steps, every actual qualified write, matching per-event raw hashes, all W/K records and GT IoUs, exclusion/sign counts, same-GPU/source binding and frozen digests with a fresh experiment audit.

Source-audit and run the immutable same-input/same-parameter C-current/C-future fit/dev design, complete own-policy history collection and fixed-final Full152 C training only under the plan gates. No future branch data/GT labels may enter deployment features.
Evaluate one final A+B+C model on complete Test50, CDTB80 and VOT127/1765, then audit all nine metrics and P1 comparisons. No C benefit or research-goal completion follows from this source audit.
